title: Plan42 specification language
facts: Specs are JSON documents with explicit module, target, inputs, nodes and implementation choices.
Operators such as call, impl_use, conditionals and assignments are interpreted by target backends.
Boundary operators must be explicit: lt and lte are not interchangeable.
strategy: Prefer the smallest declarative spec that makes inputs, effects, assumptions and expected outputs explicit.
summary: Plan42 guidance and executable evidence for plan42.spec-language
